response: Introducing Saved Views, available today across all paid plans. Saved Views let you capture the exact combination of filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most, so you can return to the perfect layout of your work in a single click, without rebuilding the same setup every morning. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving individuals and teams plenty of room to organize dashboards for sprints, backlogs, client work, or personal priorities. Once you've built a view you like, share it with your team so everyone works from the same context, whether that's a filtered board for this week's launch or a custom list tracking overdue tasks. Saved Views update automatically as your underlying data changes, so what you see stays current rather than a stale snapshot. Whether you manage a small team or a large organization, Saved Views help everyone spend less time configuring and more time doing actual work. This feature is live now for every customer on a paid plan, with no extra setup required. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
